buildCommand:
export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/flutter/bin" && printf 'SUPABASE_URL=%s
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=%s
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=%s
' "$SUPABASE_URL" "$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" "$GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID" > .env && flutter build web --release
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git $HOME/flutter --depth 1 -b stable && export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/flutter/bin" && flutter pub get
